overview: You marked two more mouths. A lord who stayed says king and means he will not kneel. A man in the press says it from habit. You wrote no new lines into either speech.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Bracketed the lord and the man in the press.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Marked two uses of king, resistance and habit
